question: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation was founded in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) was founded in **2001**.
 
• The SCO is a Eurasian political, economic, and security alliance.
 
• The founding members of the SCO include China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan.
 
• The organization aims to strengthen mutual trust and neighborliness among the member states, promote effective cooperation in politics, trade, economy, research, technology, and culture.
 
• The SCO also focuses on enhancing security and stability in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The SCO has expanded its membership over the years, with India and Pakistan becoming full members in **2017**.
 
• The organization holds annual summits and regular meetings to discuss various issues of common interest and to plan collaborative actions.
 
• The SCO's charter was signed in **2002** and entered into force in **2003**.
 
• The headquarters of the SCO is located in **Beijing, China**.
 
• The SCO also has several observer states and dialogue partners, reflecting its growing influence and reach.
